title: XBRGB-DyeCraft
description: DyeCraft is a Fabric and Neoforeg mod that introduces a complete RGB dyeing system with five dyeable block variants, an advanced Dyeing Station supporting HEX, RGB, and HSB color inputs, and dyeable crop farming for red, green, and blue dyes.
body:
DyeCraft brings a comprehensive RGB dyeing system to Minecraft (Fabric and Neoforge~~~~ 1.21.1), enabling players to apply millions of custom color shades to five different block types: stone, glass, concrete, terracotta, and wool. Colors are freely mixed through either an intuitive in-game GUI or by using precisely adjustable HEX, RGB, and HSB value input.

The centerpiece of the mod is the Dyeing Station, which allows players to dye up to 16 blocks per set of red, green, and blue vanilla dyes. It provides a real-time color preview and supports bulk dyeing that automatically calculates the required dye amount. A built-in undo feature allows reverting the most recent dye operations (up to five steps), making color correction straightforward.

To obtain the necessary dye materials, players can grow three types of dye flowers (red, green, blue) from seeds on farmland, harvest the plants, and craft them into standard Minecraft dyes. Dye plants can also be composted.

All dyeable blocks stack perfectly regardless of their source (crafting, breaking, or creative mode) and the mod integrates with Jade to display the current color’s HEX, RGB, and HSB values directly in the world. Full English and Chinese language support is included.
